rafa issue edit — append a dated update to an issue body, or replace its body or
  title, after four gates

Usage:
  rafa issue edit <n> [--append-file=<string>] [--append=<string>]
    [--reason=<string>] [--replace-file=<string>] [--title=<string>]
    [--while-in-development] [--dry-run]

Description:
  Edits one issue on the tracker the chain lands on, after four gates weighed in
  order, the first refusal ending the run with nothing written and exit code 2:
  the account editing must have write access or be in board.trustedAuthors; so
  must the issue's author; the text added must leak nothing, and a complete spec
  must stay complete; and the issue must be open, its labels and saved spec
  copies allowing the edit. An append (`--append-file` or `--append`, with
  `--reason`) adds a block `**Updated <YYYY-MM-DD>, <reason>:**` below the body,
  leaving the original part byte for byte; the same block already closing the
  body answers `already`. `--replace-file` replaces the body and `--title` the
  title. After the write the issue is read again: a body that no longer holds
  what was written answers `conflict` with exit code 1, the bodies read before
  and after saved under `.rafa/scratch/`. An append on an issue already planned
  answers `stale-copy` and names `rafa plan create --issue=<n> --refresh`, which
  it never runs. `--dry-run` prints each gate's reading and the added part and
  writes nothing. With `--output=json` the report and the tracker are the data
  of the terminal result event.

Arguments:
  n   string, required
      The issue number on the tracker.

Flags:
  --append-file            string
      A file holding the text to append, read whole; `-` reads standard input.
      Needs --reason. Not with --append, --replace-file or --title.
  --append                 string
      The text to append. Needs --reason. Not with --append-file, --replace-file
      or --title.
  --reason                 string
      Why the update was made, written into its heading. Required with an
      append, refused otherwise.
  --replace-file           string
      A file holding the new body, read whole; `-` reads standard input. Not
      with an append.
  --title                  string
      The new title, alone or beside --replace-file. Not with an append.
  --while-in-development   boolean
      Allows an append on an issue a loop has claimed, answering stale-copy.
      Only with an append.
  --dry-run                boolean
      Prints the added part and each gate's reading and writes nothing; a
      refusal still exits 2.

Examples:
  rafa issue edit 57 --append-file=update.md --reason="scope narrowed"
      Appends what update.md holds to #57 below a dated heading naming the
      reason.
  rafa issue edit 57 --append="Also covers --dry-run." --reason=clarified --dry-run
      Prints each gate's reading and the block it would append, and writes
      nothing.
  rafa issue edit 57 --title="Faster plan show"
      Changes the title of #57 and leaves its body alone.
  rafa issue edit 57 --replace-file=spec.md --output=json
      Replaces the body of #57; the report and the tracker are the data of the
      result event.

Outputs:
  text, json

See also:
  rafa issue list, rafa issue show, rafa issue create, rafa issue comment, rafa
  issue move, rafa issue ready, rafa issue unblock, rafa issue check
